title.vi: Sắc lệnh sửa đổi Sắc lệnh Cầm đồ năm 2005
title.th: คำสั่งแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมคำสั่งโรงรับจำนำ พ.ศ. 2548

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-41-2005-E-PAWNBROKERS-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2005.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 5 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Pawnbrokers (Amendment) Order, 2005 and shall commence on the same date as the Pawnbrokers Orders, 2002 (S 60/02). of section 8 of S 60/02.

Section 8 of the Pawnbrokers Order, 2002 (S 60/02), in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended in subsection (3) by deleting "$1,000" and by substituting "5,000" therefor. of section 18.

Section 18 of the principal Order is amended in subsection (1) - fa) by deleting ", in addition to the amount of the loan," in the first line; and

(b) by inserting "or such other amount as may be agreed between them" immediately after "Schedule" in the second line. of new sections 19A, 19B and 19C.

The principal Order is amended by inserting the following 3 new sections immediately after section 19 by pawnbroker. 19A. (1) pawnbroker shall provide security to the satisfaction of and in a manner determined by the Minister amounting to $100J)00.

(2) Such security shall remain in force and shall continue for 6 months following the expiration or revocation of the licence. (3} The security provided under subsection Ill shall be available to cover all damages and loss of whatsoever nature to or of any article provided to the pawnbroker. statement and accounts. 19B. Every pawnbroker shall submit to the licensing officer a financial statement together with accounts audited by a qualified auditor at the close of each financial year of the pawnbroker. Insurance. 19C. Every pawnbroker shall insure to the satisfaction of the licensing officer every article pawned to him, in respect of all damage and loss of whatsoever nature. 11 • of First Schedule.

The First Schedule to the principal Order is repealed and the following new Schedule substituted therefor - SCHEDULE 18(1) expenses and fees for safe-keeping - 50 cents per month for every $100 of the value of the article Made this 16th. day of Rabiulakhir, 1426 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of May, 2005 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
